description: Apple System Settings on macOS via a use.computer remote sandbox. System Settings is preinstalled (since macOS 13 Ventura it replaces System Preferences); install_system_settings.sh only verifies the bundle at /System/Applications/System Settings.app. setup_system_settings.sh ensures the prefs domains the tasks read (NSGlobalDomain, com.apple.dock, com.apple.menuextra.clock, com.apple.systempreferences) are in a known baseline state, and pre-creates the support directories tasks may write to. Tasks cover Appearance, Dock, Menu Bar / Control Center, Notifications, and other System-Settings-managed user preferences — all verifiable via `defaults read` of the corresponding domain (no AX-over-SSH required).
